# CodeRabbit findings for PAN-5480 (PR #5545)

CodeRabbit posted 2 inline finding(s). CodeRabbit is advisory: nothing waits for these,
but each one gets an answer, either a fix or a reply with your reason.

- Thread 4620555549 · quickstart.mdx:40 [Minor]: Provide a PATH fallback before `overdeck up`.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5545#discussion_r4620555549
- Thread 4620555571 · quickstart.mdx:43 [Major]: On Linux, `up` selects the installed CLI as the desktop app.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5545#discussion_r4620555571

## What to do

1. Read each thread (open its link, or the code at the path and line).
2. If you agree with a finding, fix it.
3. If you reject a finding, reply on its thread with your reason:
   `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/pulls/5545/comments/<thread id>/replies -f body="<reason>"`
4. If you changed code: run the quality gates on what you touched, commit, push, then run `pan review request PAN-5480 -m "CodeRabbit <thread ids>: <what you changed>"`.
   If you only replied, you are done.
5. If PR #5545 has already merged when you read this, stop: after the merge Overdeck files a follow-up issue
   for every thread with no reply, no later commit to its file, and no re-review request naming its thread id.
